biggest_catch: PSG only pays if you match their current research criteria — but at $200 per plasma donation, it pays roughly 3-4x what a regular plasma center pays per visit.
catches: This is niche by design: PSG recruits people with specific conditions/medications for diagnostic-research plasma (specialty/disease-state donors).
Payment method and timing are not published — confirm before donating.
Plasma collections happen at FDA-registered centers — travel may be involved.
One study at a time; not an everyday side hustle for everyone.

eligibility: Varies by study — PSG recruits specialty plasma donors (people with recent medical diagnoses or autoimmune conditions); standard donor screening applies; FDA donation limits (2x per 7 days)
maximize: Fill out PSG's donor form at plasmaservicesgroup.com/donor-form/ and list every diagnosis and medication — matching is how you get picked for the $200/donation studies. Their site also runs 'current paid studies' (see PSGDonors.com); each new study is a new payout. Ask about payment method and timing when they contact you.
notes: Official plasmaservicesgroup.com/donor-form/ verified 2026-09-23: '$200.00 per donation'. PSG's Director of Business Development also stated on the record (PhillyVoice Q&A) that PSG pays $100 for at-home blood sample collections — kept as secondary context only, not the verified route.

We generally compensate all of our donors $200.00 per donation for their time and efforts.

repeatable.cadence: Per paid collection: each study or collection event is a separate $200 payout, repeatable across studies as long as you keep matching their research criteria.
repeatable.note: Each collection/study is a separate paid event at $200/donation; repeatable across studies while you qualify.

s3.note: Catches: condition-matching, unpublished payment timing, center travel

steps: Check plasmaservicesgroup.com for the donor program and current recruiting needs
Fill out the official donor form with your diagnoses and medications
If matched, donate specialty plasma at an FDA-registered center at $200 per donation
Stay on file for future paid studies
timing: $200 per donation (official); payment method/timing not published — confirm with PSG
who_pays: Plasma Services Group pays $200 per donation — but the official site does not name the payment method, so ask how (check, card, direct deposit) before you donate.
who_qualifies: This is specialty research plasma: PSG recruits people with specific conditions or medications (recent diagnoses, autoimmune conditions) — healthy donors don't qualify. Standard donor screening still applies, and FDA donation limits apply (2x per 7 days).
work_available: PSG's $200-per-donation donor program is posted live on plasmaservicesgroup.com as of 2026-09-23, but this is niche by design — you only get in if you match their current research criteria, one study at a time. Fill out their donor form to be considered.
what_gets_accepted: You must match their recruiting criteria AND pass the screening AND complete the donation — failing any of those means no pay. This is diagnostic-research plasma, not a walk-in donation center.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Collections happen at FDA-registered centers — travel may be involved. Screening, the donation session itself (up to about 2 hours), and any waiting are unpaid. This is a research setting with a needle, not everyday side-hustle money for everyone.
when_cash_arrives: Payment method and timing are not published on PSG's official site — confirm when and how you're paid before donating.
